purpose: Fresh 36-case confirmation set, with word identities withheld while model architecture is finalized; score once on the frozen final production output. None of these words appears in the main or development-extension fixtures. Thresholds unchanged from the main suite except no core-only subset.

cases.rationale: Thankful appreciation counters angry displeasure under the game policy of positive feelings countering anger.

allowedSenses.definition: a feeling of thankfulness and appreciation

cases.rationale: Contentment or allayed feelings counter angry displeasure.

allowedSenses.definition: filled with satisfaction
allayed

cases.rationale: Being furious reinforces anger; emitting smoke does not.

allowedSenses.definition: be mad, angry, or furious

cases.rationale: An annoyed and irritable disposition reinforces anger; a crossing or religious symbol does not.

allowedSenses.definition: annoyed and irritable

cases.rationale: A vessel or its shape does not intrinsically express an emotional response to anger.
A dish, sheet, or surface is not intrinsically an emotional response to anger.

expect and wish

cases.rationale: A grammatical cause marker has no intrinsic hopeful or hopeless content.

cause fear in
